summary: Describes a URN namespace for the Common Language Equipment Identifier (CLEI) code used in ANSI-standardized messages. The CLEI code is a globally unique ten-character code, and the namespace is managed by Telcordia Technologies as maintenance agent for ANSI T1.213. It is informational.

eli5.summary: Telephone equipment gets a short ID code so everyone knows exactly which gadget is meant. This memo lets those ID codes be written as proper internet names.

questions: how is equipment identified in telecommunications
subtitle: A Uniform Resource Name namespace for equipment identifiers in telecommunications

tldr.problem: The telecommunications industry needed a standardized way to reference equipment using the Common Language Equipment Identifier (CLEI) code within internet naming systems.
tldr.mechanism: RFC 4152 defines a URN namespace named CLEI managed by Telcordia Technologies, allowing the 10-character alphanumeric CLEI codes to be referenced as internet resources using the syntax URN:CLEI:xxxxxxxx.
tldr.outcome: The CLEI URN namespace enables telecommunications equipment to be identified and managed across internet systems and messages, providing stability and uniqueness for inventory, logistics, and asset tracking.

today: RFC 4152 is an Informational RFC published in August 2005. The CLEI URN namespace is registered with IANA and remains the standard way for telecommunications systems to reference equipment using CLEI codes as internet identifiers.

sections.title: Introduction
sections.content:
Many circuit cards used in the global telecommunications network have a Common Language Equipment Identifier (CLEI) code assigned to them, printed as a bar code or two-dimensional symbol on a label. Service providers use CLEI codes to track inventory (both working equipment and spare parts), handle logistics (moving cards and tracking serial numbers), provision equipment, and maintain accounting records.

This RFC defines a URN (Uniform Resource Name) namespace for CLEI codes so they can be referenced as stable, internet-standard identifiers. The URN namespace is managed by Telcordia Technologies as the maintenance agent for ANSI T1.213, ensuring uniqueness and persistence of the names.
sections.eli5: Telephone equipment gets a short code. This memo lets people refer to that code using the internet naming system so everyone agrees on what equipment is being discussed.

sections.title: What is a CLEI Code
sections.content:
A CLEI code is a 10-character alphanumeric intelligent code that encodes information about telecommunications equipment. The code has four data elements. The first two characters identify the technology or equipment type (such as D4CE for a D4 channel bank). The next two characters denote the functional sub-category. The third data element consists of three characters representing features and functional capabilities or changes. The fourth data element has a single character referencing a manufacturer, system ID, specification or drawing. Finally, two characters provide complementary data, typically identifying the manufacturing vintage of the product.

There is a one-to-one relationship between a CLEI code and the supplier's product ID (the manufacturer's name and part number along with its version). Codes are assigned by Telcordia according to ANSI standards and are never reassigned, ensuring permanent binding between the name and its resource.
sections.eli5: Each code tells you what kind of equipment it is, what features it has, who made it, and how old it is.

sections.title: URN Namespace and Examples
sections.content:
The CLEI URN namespace is identified by the namespace ID CLEI and uses a flat space of ten characters as defined in the ANSI standards. Examples of CLEI URNs include URN:CLEI:D4CE18B7AA, URN:CLEI:D4CE4248AA, and URN:CLEI:SNPWBBC7AA. These three examples represent D4CE equipment from different manufacturers (Nortel Networks, Lear, and Lucent Technologies) with different feature sets.

Lexical equivalence of CLEI URN namespace specific strings is defined as an exact, case-insensitive string match. CLEI codes are assigned in a case-insensitive fashion, so no two codes differ only in case. Telcordia URNs are resolved via Telcordia resolvers run under Telcordia responsibility, with further information available at www.commonlanguage.com.
sections.eli5: A CLEI URN looks like URN:CLEI: followed by the 10-character code. Different manufacturers and models get different codes.

sections.title: Application and Benefits
sections.content:
CLEI codes have historically been used in a wide variety of communications equipment. Circumstances exist where entities with CLEI codes need to be managed or exposed in a larger context, such as the general internet. In these cases, the use of the CLEI URN namespace provides interoperability benefits to the internet at large and to specific internets.

The namespace enables equipment to be referenced in internet messages, databases, and systems using a standardized, persistent identifier. This is particularly valuable in environments where different systems, vendors, and organizations need to coordinate on equipment identification and management.
sections.eli5: Internet systems and messages can now refer to equipment using these standard codes, making it easier for different companies and systems to talk about the same equipment.
